input.quote: ARTICLE III OWNERSHIP Licensee acknowledges that Licensor owns all right, title, and interest in and to the Licensed Technology and all Intellectual Property Rights therein.
input.rationale: Article III (p0048) vests all right, title and interest in the Licensed Technology and all Intellectual Property Rights in Licensor, and the definition of Intellectual Property Rights (p0015) expressly sweeps in "all additions, improvements and accessions" to Licensor's materials, while "Derivative Work" (p0005) captures any additions, modifications or enhancements incorporating the Licensed Technology. The result is that the bespoke customization we commission and pay for under Article VII(b) (p0087) — including a unique client front end — is owned by Licensor, and our only rights are the non-exclusive, Field-of-Use-limited licence that expires with the 36-month term (renewable at Licensor's option, p0049). There is no assignment of deliverables to us and no perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence back, so the clause fails both the preferred and the fallback position. The Agreement also contains no ownership statement for our data (only a Confidential Information definition covering information disclosed to us, p0004). Licensor's ownership of its own pre-existing platform is acceptable and is preserved. Redline adds Licensee ownership of paid-for deliverables with a perpetual licence to embedded Licensor IP, retention of Licensee Data rights, and a no-joint-ownership statement.

proposal.summary: Add Licensee ownership of paid-for customization deliverables (with perpetual licence to embedded Licensor IP) and Licensee ownership of its data to Article III.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article III gives Licensor ownership of the Licensed Technology and of all additions and improvements, including the custom front end and other customization work we commission and pay for under Article VII(b), with no ownership or surviving licence for us and no provision for our own data. We have added a short paragraph so that we own the deliverables we fund (Licensor keeping its pre-existing platform IP, which we license perpetually where embedded) and retain all rights in our data; if Licensor cannot assign the customization deliverables, we can accept our fallback of a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense them.

ops.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing: (i) Licensee shall own all right, title and interest in and to any customization work, unique client front end, configurations and other deliverables developed by Licensor specifically for Licensee and paid for by Licensee (including under Article VII(b)) (the "Licensee Deliverables"), and Licensor hereby assigns all Intellectual Property Rights therein to Licensee, excluding Licensor's pre-existing Licensed Technology, in respect of which Licensor grants Licensee a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense such pre-existing materials solely as embedded in the Licensee Deliverables; and (ii) Licensee retains all right, title and interest in and to all data, orders, records and other information provided or generated by or on behalf of Licensee in connection with its use of the Licensed Technology ("Licensee Data"), and nothing in this Agreement transfers or assigns any ownership of Licensee Data or any other Licensee intellectual property to Licensor. No deliverable, Licensee Data or Intellectual Property Rights shall be jointly owned by the parties.
